answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Anchor: each identity must solve a fresh, randomly seeded task whose answer is a one-time token bound to that agent, and the token chain is checkpointed against a public onyx ledger so reused answers are rejected. Enforcement requires every token to harbor a distinct random seed traceable to the issuing round, so copied answers fail the seed match. An attacker must pay for fresh compute per identity and cannot amortize one answer across many agents, making mass identity creation cost real work each time.
